# Vendored third-party code

**qrcode.min.js** — QR Code Generator for JavaScript by Kazuhiko Arase.
MIT License. Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
(npm package `qrcode-generator`, version 2.0.4, file `dist/qrcode.js`,
copied verbatim). Used on the Display & QR admin page to draw the QR
code entirely client-side — no external service call, no network
dependency at runtime.
